title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 44 ]

items.text: I took it for granted that he would marry her.
It grew so hot that we turned on the air conditioner.
It was when I was attending a pop concert that I saw her for the first time.
Political analysts are just as convinced that Clinton will beat Dole as they were that Reagan would beat Mondale.
The soldiers were lining up for dinner when they were attacked.
I don't know when he will return.
Do you know why he cannot come?
His father died on the day when he was born.
I don't know the name of the town where he went.
Drop by my house when you happen to be in the neighborhood.
Put back the book where you found it.
He showed me how he had succeeded.
